name: Archaeological Site of Carthage
description: Carthage lies on the Gulf of Tunis, now a seaside suburb of Tunisia's capital. Founded in the 9th century B.C., it grew into a Mediterranean trading power until Rome razed it in 146 B.C. and built a new city on top. Today you can wander scattered ruins around Byrsa hill, where foundations, column fragments and sweeping views show the city's former scale.
